topic: Data loss and calibration fix for partner
summary_markdown:
The conversation shifted from personal matters to technical data issues. A query was run attempting to find device activity (`raw_devices_seen_2`) for a specific company ID, noting that data appeared missing or lost around March 8th.

[me] eventually located the issue and implemented a fix (a 'фикшу'). The problem involved incorrect default calibration settings being used when transferring Finnish partner data from Media Audit Finland Oy to replace JCD HQ.
decisions: The necessary fix was applied to correct the default calibration for the new Finnish partner data.
